# Roleplay Rule 21 - Contraband Use
Command and Security personnel may not use major, syndicate, or magical contraband unless it has been properly authorized or its use is permitted under the exceptions outlined below. Unauthorized use of these types of contraband is prohibited, regardless of whether the character could otherwise reasonably access or operate the item.
## Precedents - The Captain can permit the crew use of minor and major contraband, syndicate and magical contraband can only be authorized by a CCO (the NTR and BSO cannot authorize its use). Any authorization granted by the Captain must have a reasonable in-character justification, which may be subject to administrative scrutiny at the discretion of the admin team. [bold]Such permits are allowed by roleplay laws but are not protected under [textlink="Space Law" link="SpaceLaw"].[/bold] - Restrictions on contraband use are lifted if the station enters Delta Alert, Amber alert, warops is declared, an antagonist has ascended, or there is a similar existential threat to the station. - Leeway to this rule is given if the contraband was utilized out of necessity. An example of this is grabbing the energy sword a syndie dropped and using it to kill the syndie in self defence. However, keeping that energy sword for later use would be considered a violation of RPR 21.
